original_test_intent: Verify the Height metadata of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 enclosure matches the approved chassis rack-unit height or an explicitly supported unspecified value and remains stable after reboot; it is not a physical measurement test.
original_method: Capture full Type 3 records, bind the enclosure by serial/asset/type/BOM identity, extract raw and decoded Height, interpret the field in its SMBIOS-defined rack-unit semantics when applicable, compare with the approved chassis specification, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the enclosure, expected rack-unit value or supported-unspecified policy and reboot plan. Metadata collection and exact comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved chassis Height in rack units or explicit supported-unspecified state
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not open or physically measure the enclosure under this case.
Preserve complete Type 3 output and raw field value; do not infer centimeters/inches from a rack-unit encoding.
Do not assume the first Type 3 record or accept zero/unspecified without an approved applicability rule.
Do not add arbitrary dimensional tolerance to an integral metadata enumeration unless the project explicitly defines one.
Stop on malformed value, mapping ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 records, bind the enclosure and compare raw/decoded Height with the approved rack-unit baseline before/after reboot.
Do not claim physical measurement, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field applicability, target enclosure and expected rack-unit/unspecified policy.
Resolve SMBIOS metadata versus mechanical drawing differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep alone loses record identity and raw/applicability semantics, suppresses errors and uses insecure transport assumptions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 3 output with tool/errors, select the enclosure by correlated identity and retain both raw Height byte and decoded rack-unit display.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Height field, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify structure/version applicability, bind the enclosure, compare the raw Height field and decoded rack-unit count against the approved chassis/BOM definition, and govern zero/unspecified explicitly across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 3 records whose formatted length/version includes Height, especially rack-mount chassis.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and mechanical/BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 Height field semantics, approved chassis drawing/BOM and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-value, rack-unit and applicability semantics without introducing physical measurement.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; physical dimension verification remains separate if required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected U height or supported unspecified policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware metadata can disagree with actual mechanical construction; this case validates the reported field only.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept zero/unspecified for a non-rack or unsupported platform only with documented field applicability; it may separately require manual mechanical measurement without changing this case's automation class.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected U height/unspecified policy, field applicability, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 record plus raw/decoded Height comparison
Engineer verdict and separate mechanical evidence reference if required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and persistence criterion consistently target Type 3 Height metadata; missing expected U value is a project input gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field is safely readable and semantically identifiable; applicability and expected value affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps metadata-versus-physical separation while removing an unsupported generic tolerance assumption and correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds structure-length/version applicability and explicit zero handling.

review_improvement: Prevents unit conversion errors, wrong-enclosure acceptance, unsupported zero values and false claims of physical measurement.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source is an SMBIOS information-field check; once the expected rack-unit/applicability data are supplied, all core operations are software-controlled.
